item.title: DU loses Tk18.36cr annually
item.description: Dhaka University (DU), one of the country's premier educational institutions, is reportedly losing a staggering Tk 18.36 crore every year due to an organised syndicate that manipulates shop rents at university-owned markets. item.title: Rising external debt raises alarm despite remittance surge
item.description: Inflows of workers' remittance into Bangladesh have surged sharply, providing welcome support to foreign currency reserves even as the country's external debt continues to climb.On December 9, remittance receipts reached US$154 million. item.title: 2 varsity students killed as DSCC truck smashes motorcycle

item.title: 6.7-magnitude earthquake shakes Japan, tsunami issued

item.title: BCB congratulates Asif Nazrul on new advisory role

item.title: Duffy takes five as NZ thrash West Indies for 1-0 Test series lead

item.title: Asif Mahmud to contest polls as independent candidate
item.description: Asif Mahmud Shojib Bhuiyan has announced that he will contest the upcoming national election as an independent candidate from Dhaka-10.
